scene: The drone projects shimmering route maps pointing toward three waiting transit docks.
picture: Side view across the nursery transit terrace. The grandfather stands with his bicycle left of centre, watching the glowing drone hover. On the far left, a giant orange koi-shaped boat floats in a canal. At the centre sits an idling green retro streetcar. On the far right, a sleek white bento express train waits.
